data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Utilize Chart.js to create various data visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with charts
Charts are interactive and visually appealing

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include actual data from recent runs to demonstrate Artemis's capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are included in the presentation
Data is accurate and up-to-date
Metrics are presented in an engaging manner

features.title: Display Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for LLM cost, stage completion rates, and success rate trends.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost is shown over time with a line chart
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart

features.title: Integrate Supervisor Across Stages
features.description: Demonstrate supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart shows supervisor integration
Integration is clearly explained
Chart is interactive and informative

features.title: Highlight Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Showcase TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays code quality metrics
TDD compliance is clearly represented
SOLID principles are highlighted

features.title: Visualize 8-Stage Pipeline
features.description: Create a visualization of the 8-stage pipeline using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline stages are clearly represented
Chart.js is used for the visualization
Visualization is accurate and easy to understand

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis self-demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML
Chart.js is included for data visualization

features.title: Showcase HERO Section
features.description: Introduce Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System in the HERO section.
acceptance_criteria: HERO section clearly defines Artemis
Content is engaging and informative
Visuals support the introduction of Artemis

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement functionality for slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Users can manually navigate through slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions into the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a gradient background
Transitions between slides are smooth
Overall design is professional and cohesive
